text:
I gave birth when I was on the A5 visa. I was eligible for maternity benefits as I worked for the alotted time. However, Bituach  Leumi had a lot of my information wrong in their system even though I was on A5 for more than four years,  so it took a few weeks for me to actually get the benefits. Also, they never reached out to me. It was always my husband and I reaching out to them. 

Additionally, my A5 was up for renewal toward the end of my maternity benefit time so BL only paid me until the date I was suppose to be renewed….and then gave me the rest after Misrad hapnim renewed my visa where I was being considered for citizenship (I am now a citizen).

It was really annoying and time consuming. My husband had to go and yell at them a few times. They kept fixing their errors in how much they owed me.
